messages:
sara_k: Quick sync — proposing a phased regional rollout for Marketplace to minimize risk and give SI partners a clear handoff window.

sara_k: Plan sketch:
``` 
Day 1 (EU morning): enable catalog + press muted -> limited PR (partners only)
Day 1 afternoon: SI on-call handover (EMEA SI teams)
Day 2 (NA): enable listing + coordinated press lift 10:00 PT
Day 3 (APAC): soft enable, monitor, then full PR 09:00 SGT
``` 
sara_k: Need: marketing press embargo schedule, legal signoff on co-ann language, SI readiness + runbook, infra capacity checks. Thoughts?

jason_w: Love the phase idea. Can we gate NA press on SLA metrics? e.g., p95 < 250ms for search routes.
jason_w: I'll ask comms to prepare 3 press variants: global, regional, partner-focused. ETA EOD today.

elaine_m: @sara_k @jason_w pls add a short FAQ for partner pages (who to contact, support SLAs, how to onboard). I'll draft.

mike_l: Quick legal check: co-branding clause needs partner approval for logos. Also embargo window must be explicit (date/time + timezone). Will review the messaging doc — share draft.

tom_s: SI side: confirmed EMEA SI runbook ready. Need a cutover signal and post-cutover rollback plan. Who is owner for the cutover signal? @ben_ops?

ben_ops: I'll own the cutover signal. Proposal: we use the deploy bot + a single slack msg in #release-war-room with stage tag. Example: /deploy marketplace enable-region eu -> then I post "CUTOVER: EU live".

partners-bot: Linked checklist -> https://issues.example.com/RED-1234 (marketplace phased rollout checklist)

jason_w: Also scheduling a 30m dry run with partners tomorrow 09:00 PT. Calendar invite: https://cal.example.com/dryrun (accept if you're involved)

sara_k: Perfect. Action items:
- jason_w: press variants + schedule
- elaine_m: partner FAQ + landing copy
- mike_l: legal review + embargo language
- tom_s: SI rollback plan
- ben_ops: infra cutover signal + runbook link
Please update RED-1234 when done. :thumbsup:

tom_s: Will upload SI runbook to RED-1234 after the dry run.

mike_l: I'll post the legal signoff as a comment on RED-1234 by 5pm PT.

jason_w: PRs ready, will hold for legal. If legal OK, we lift NA press at 10:00 PT Day 2.

sara_k: Great — closing the loop. If anything changes ping me directly. :rocket:
